fusions.name: Kicked Grit
fusions.desc: Kicks 3 shards of grit in a spread, each dealing 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Nudged Off the Ledge
fusions.desc: Tips a boulder at the first enemy in line for 28 damage. It bursts, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Gone to Ground
fusions.desc: Raises a skin of stone that absorbs 20 damage and raises your armour by 5% for 8 seconds. Using it increases your movement speed by 15% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sure-Footed on Stone
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
